facts.value: In the Business English Foundation course, students learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. A variety of exercises are aimed at promoting linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics, forming the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects. The reading and writing component of the course will be assessed in a 90-minute written exam in the last week of the semester.
